remarks: Bright Corner Unit with City Views in the Heart of Downtown Stamford! Welcome home to this spacious and sun-filled 2-bedroom corner unit, perfectly situated in the heart of downtown Stamford. Featuring beautiful hardwood floors throughout, this inviting home offers an open-concept living and dining area with sliding glass doors leading to a private balcony where you can enjoy picturesque city views. The updated kitchen is fully equipped with a refrigerator, dishwasher, and microwave, providing both functionality and convenience. The generously sized primary bedroom features two large closets, while the second bedroom offers flexibility for guests, a home office, or additional living space. A spacious full bathroom and abundant closet space throughout the unit add to its appeal. Residents enjoy the convenience of on-site laundry, assigned parking (Space #51), and rent that includes heat (up to 55F), hot water, and one parking space. Ideally located just steps from downtown Stamford's vibrant restaurants, shopping, entertainment, the library, public transportation, and Stamford Town Center Mall, this home offers the perfect blend of comfort, convenience, and city living.
